must.title: Security Compliance
must.description: Ensure aliased ports comply with security standards.
must.metric: No critical vulnerabilities in security scans.
acceptance_criteria: Security scans show no critical vulnerabilities.
Security policies are documented and enforced.

must.title: Reliability
must.description: Ensure the system is reliable and available.
acceptance_criteria: Monitoring shows 99.9% uptime over a rolling 30-day window.
Redundancy and failover mechanisms are in place.
Incident response procedures are documented and tested.

should.title: Performance Optimization
should.description: Ensure the aliased ports perform efficiently under expected load conditions.
should.metric: Response time under 200ms for 95% of requests.
acceptance_criteria: Performance tests show response times under 200ms for 95% of requests.
Load testing confirms system stability under peak load.
Performance benchmarks are documented and met.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99.

should.title: Scalability
should.description: The system should scale to support future growth.
should.metric: System supports 2x current user load without degradation.
acceptance_criteria: Scalability tests confirm support for 2x current user load.
should.verification: Scalability testing with simulated load increase.

should.title: Usability
should.description: Ensure the system is user-friendly and accessible.
should.metric: User satisfaction score of 4.5/5 or higher.
acceptance_criteria: Usability testing shows a user satisfaction score of 4.5/5 or higher.
Accessibility standards are met according to WCAG 2.1.
User feedback is collected and addressed.
should.verification: Usability testing and user feedback analysis.
